grammar.numbers: a mini gold card dealt face-down into the lane under the logo and turned over to the number (counts up; a year or date shown as said), a stat's own label beside it
grammar.comparisons: one hero card in 3D: the first card's title and rows on the navy-foil front, the second's on the gold-foil back; it turns over on its Y axis (sheen, stretching shadow) once the first value is read, the second card's title waiting on a ribbon; after it a ribbon unfurls with the reel's own question, or a difference only when the first rows share a label and both parse in the same unit
grammar.steps: a deck: each point dealt off a face-down stack and turned face-up as it is said, earlier ones fanned behind top-down in spoken order, the current one gold
grammar.change: the hero card: TRƯỚC front (label, old value) turns over at the swap to the SAU back (new value, an arrow only when the cue gives a direction, the old value small on a pill); a difference ribbon only when both values parse with the same unit
grammar.trend: classic line graph panel (MotionTrack, kept above the caption strip)
grammar.lenders: the hero card turns over to a white face with the logo and a neutral label; named while the stage is busy, a small white chip on the lane's right
grammar.captionPosition: fixed dark strip under the stage, keywords gold, the word being said lifted on a small gold card; English line in italics under it

skinAxes.cover: logo tile on white, the card dealt face-down and turned over to the title on its gold face, subtitle under it
skinAxes.captions: bold white on a dark rounded strip with a faint gold edge, keywords gold, current word on a tilted gold card
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; the hero card floats and tilts on a dark navy stage with soft bokeh (parallax)
skinAxes.transitions: cards dealt in from below with a small spin, Y-axis turn-overs with a sheen and a stretching shadow; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: navy and gold foil guilloche faces, soft blue and gold bokeh, light sweeps across the card
skinAxes.sound: voice + a whoosh on the change turn-over, clicks on dealt points and compare cards
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
